δινήεντι: δινήεις — eddying, whirling; masc. dat. sg., epithet of a river

παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.

πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’

πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for herself’
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)

πολύδακρυν: πολύδακρυς — tearful, bringing many tears; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἄρηα or πόλεμον
πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέρα: ’a great (mist)’

πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

πυρὰ: πῦρ — fire; neut. acc. pl. πυρά, of watch-fires: ’fires’

πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πόρκης: πόρκης — ring, band (fastening the spear-head to the shaft); masc. nom. sg.

τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.

τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’)

φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρει: φέρω — bear, carry; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’carries’
φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’

φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)

φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
χρύσεος: χρύσεος — golden; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦς)

ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)

ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’speak’ (μὴ … ἀγόρευε ’do not speak’)

ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀλεγίζω: ἀλεγίζω — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., usually with a negative

ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμφίς: ἀμφίς — on both sides, around; adv., or postpositive prep. + acc.: ’round about’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)

ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.

ἀπονοστήσειν: ἀπονοστέω — return home, come back; fut. inf. act.

ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀριπρεπέα: ἀριπρεπής — very conspicuous, outstanding; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with παῖδ’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοῖς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl.

ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’

ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.

ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)

ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
ἐπιθρῴσκων: ἐπιθρῴσκω — leap upon; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’leaping upon’

ἐρεισάμενος: ἐρείδω — prop, lean; mid. lean on; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaning (on)’
ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’)

ἐϋμμελίω: ἐϋμμελίης — with good ash-spear; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -ω (= Attic -ου)

ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔλπομαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + inf.: ’I expect’
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., predicate
ἔναρα: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from a slain foe; neut. acc. pl., object of φέροι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)

ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠνεμόεσσαν: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept (ἄνεμος); adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; fem. acc. sg., with ὑπό: ’beneath the dawn’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ τ’ ἠέλιόν τε ’under dawn and sun’)
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’) · also ἰῷ = Attic μιᾷ, ’one’, dat. sg. agreeing with ἤματι (ἰῷ … ἤματι ’on a single day’)
ἱπποδάμοις: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming, tamer of horses; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with Τρώεσσι
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴλιος: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. nom. sg.
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἵκῃ): ’you may reach’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλύρας: ὀλύρα — emmer, a coarse grain; fem. acc. pl.
ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων)
ὄψεαι: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὄψει)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὑπερμενέα: ὑπερμενής — of surpassing strength; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with Κρονίωνα
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’)
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
ῥοάων: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
